capabilities: Open draggable, stackable floating sticky windows backed by vault notes
Filter, sort, pin, and paginate stickies in a sidebar list
View a dashboard with quick access, calendar heatmap, and workspace tree
Save and switch window layouts as sticky workspaces
Drag stickies onto Canvas as file or text nodes
extras: Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese). Installation via BRAT is supported for beta versions. The Shift-drag Canvas option moves the original note to trash, which the README flags as use with care.
problem: Obsidian notes open only inside panes, so there is no sticker-style floating window for quick, always-visible notes layered over the UI.

relations.evidence: obsidian-card-note — card-style notes and floating UI ideas
obsidian-hover-editor — floating editor and window behavior

summary: Floating sticky-note windows over the vault, each backed by an Obsidian note, with a list, dashboard, workspaces, and Canvas integration.
